plan: No theme this morning: no two names are moving for the same reason, and the industry groups have no shared news. UMAC has the clearest reason, an Oppenheimer initiation, but its premarket volume is still light. INHD and GMM have the real volume with no news behind them, and GMM has traded many times its float, so expect fast moves and possible halts. Most watchlist names carry Watch or High dilution flags, and 424B prospectus filings could not be checked today.
